slides.0.title: The seven AOCs and when they began
slides.0.subtitle: The 2001 order lists every founding order
slides.1.title: The seven AOCs
slides.1.highlights.0.title: The list
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Mornag, Grand Cru Mornag, Coteaux de Tébourba, Sidi Salem, Kélibia, Thibar and Coteaux d'Utique
slides.1.highlights.1.title: The Muscat names
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Kélibia also has "Muscat de Kélibia" and "Vin Muscat de Kélibia", and Thibar has "Muscat de Thibar". These are Muscat names within the same regions and are not usually counted as separate AOCs
slides.1.highlights.2.title: The official basis
slides.1.highlights.2.content: The order of 27 February 2001 opens by listing each AOC's founding order and amendments. "Seven" is the usual count; the order itself gives no total
slides.1.content: Learn the seven names first, then put them in order.
slides.2.title: 1958 to 1977
slides.2.highlights.0.title: 1958: Muscat first
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Orders of 18 September define Muscat de Kélibia and Muscat de Thibar
slides.2.highlights.1.title: 1973: Tébourba, Sidi Salem and Mornag
slides.2.highlights.1.content: Coteaux de Tébourba and Sidi Salem were created on 23 July. Earlier, on 19 May, Mornag was created as a VDQS (delimited wine of superior quality)
slides.2.highlights.2.content: Kélibia and Thibar were created on 11 February 1976. On 27 July 1977 came Grand Cru Mornag and a new order for "Thibar" and "Muscat de Thibar"
slides.2.content: Kélibia and Thibar each had a Muscat order in 1958 and another AOC order in 1976. This course could not read how the two orders divide the work.
slides.3.title: 1980 to 1999
slides.3.highlights.0.title: 1980: Coteaux d'Utique
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Created on 14 April 1980 and amended on 14 March 1986. Sidi Salem and Thibar were amended the same day in 1980
slides.3.highlights.1.title: 1989: Mornag becomes an AOC
slides.3.highlights.1.content: An order of 16 March 1989 governs AOC Mornag, amended on 2 October 1999. Going from VDQS to AOC, Mornag is the latest of all
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Grand Cru Mornag
slides.3.highlights.2.content: It was created in 1977, twelve years before AOC Mornag. "Grand Cru" is part of the appellation's name
slides.3.content: The earliest are the Muscats (1958) and the latest is Mornag (1989).
slides.4.componentProps.slide.title: 🧠 Knowledge check
In which year were the first appellations created?
Muscat de Kélibia and Muscat de Thibar, both on 18 September.
What was Mornag created as in 1973?
It became an AOC by order only in 1989.
Which came first, Grand Cru Mornag or AOC Mornag?
A. Grand Cru Mornag does not exist yet
B. Grand Cru Mornag, by twelve years
C. AOC Mornag, by twelve years
Grand Cru Mornag dates from 1977 and AOC Mornag from 1989.
